role: Temporal read queries for the Co-Being knowledge graph; snapshot reconstruction and provenance retrieval.
detail: Provides two async functions for querying a knowledge graph at a specific point in time (get_scene_at) and retrieving provenance chains for nodes (get_provenance_chain). get_scene_at returns all nodes valid at a given timestamp by filtering on valid_from <= timestamp and (valid_to is None OR valid_to > timestamp), treating valid_to as an exclusive upper bound. get_provenance_chain wraps a single Provenance record in a list for forward compatibility with multi-provenance evolution. Both functions accept any GraphPersistence backend (in-memory or Neo4j) and apply filtering in Python rather than via backend-specific query language. Returns empty list if no matches found or node does not exist.
gotchas: Temporal snapshot assumes timezone-aware UTC datetimes; naive datetime comparisons against timezone-aware node timestamps will raise TypeError. valid_to boundary is exclusive (half-open interval convention). In Phase 1 every node carries exactly one Provenance record; get_provenance_chain returns single-element list but signature designed for future multi-provenance support.
